label: Title creation piety cost
summary: Changes the piety cost of creating a title, as a percentage.
details: It works on a character. A negative value makes creating titles cheaper in piety and a positive one makes it dearer.

label: Tolerance advantage
summary: A character modifier named for an advantage tied to tolerance; the game gives it no display name or description.
details: It works on a character. The input does not say what the advantage applies to or how much it changes per point.

label: Travel companion opinion
summary: Changes the opinion of travel companions, going by the game's name for it.
details: It works on a character. The input does not say whose opinion of whom it is, or whether the amount is flat or a percentage.

label: Travel danger
summary: Changes the travel danger, a game concept the input does not explain further.
details: It works on a character, a province and a county. The input does not say what a point means.

label: Travel safety
summary: Adds to the safety of a travel plan (a journey).
details: It works on a travel plan, not on a character. It has a percentage twin, travel_safety_mult, so this one is the flat version. A negative value lowers the safety.

label: Travel safety (percent)
summary: Changes the safety of a travel plan (a journey) by a percentage.
details: It works on a travel plan. The flat version is travel_safety.

label: Travel speed
summary: Adds to the speed of a travel plan (a journey).
details: It works on a travel plan, not on a character. It has a percentage twin, travel_speed_mult, so this one is the flat version. A negative value slows the journey.

label: Travel speed (percent)
summary: Changes the speed of a travel plan (a journey) by a percentage.
details: It works on a travel plan. The flat version is travel_speed.

label: Tyranny gain

details: It works on a character. A negative value means they gain less tyranny.

label: Tyranny loss
